description: End-to-end test suite for organization invitation flows using Playwright, testing email invites, invite links, user migration, and booking scenarios within the organization context.

methods.name: signupFromInviteLink
methods.description: Automates user signup process from an invite link, filling email and password, then navigating to onboarding pages.

methods.name: signupFromEmailInviteLink
methods.description: Automates user signup process from an email invite link, verifying pre-filled username and email, then completing registration.

methods.name: inviteAnEmail
methods.description: Sends an invitation email to a specified address, optionally within a team context.

methods.name: expectUserToBeAMemberOfOrganization
methods.description: Verifies a user's membership status, role, and acceptance state within an organization.

methods.name: expectUserToBeAMemberOfTeam
methods.description: Verifies a user's membership status, role, and acceptance state within a team.

methods.name: assertInviteLink
methods.description: Asserts that an invite link is valid and not null or undefined.

methods.name: copyInviteLink
methods.description: Copies an invite link from the UI, optionally within a team context.
